name: Rigi Kulm to Rigi Kaltbad
why: Down from the 'queen of the mountains' with Lake Lucerne on three sides and a line of Alps from the Säntis to the Jungfrau.
book: Boat to Vitznau and cog railway to Rigi Kulm (Swiss Travel Pass valid).

points.name: Rigi Kulm
points.note: The summit and old hotel above the lakes.

points.name: Rigi Kaltbad
points.note: A resort on a terrace with the lake below.
